title: Rosengartenschlucht Imst
highlights: Zweikilometerlanger geologischer Lehrpfad direkt vom Stadtzentrum Imst nach Hoch-Imst
Spektakulaerer Schinderbach mit tosenden Kaskaden, Felsengalerien und Holzstegen
Geheimnisvolle Blaue Grotte, in der schon zur Roemerzeit nach Silber geschuerft wurde
Wertvolles Biotop mit seltenen Moosen, Farnen und kuehlem Gebirgsklima im Sommer
kurzbeschreibung: The Rosengartenschlucht in Imst leads across wooden footbridges and rock-cut steps along the Schinderbach to the mysterious Blaue Grotte.
beschreibung:
From the Town Square Directly into the Wild Riverbed

The Rosengartenschlucht is a unique natural jewel located right in Imst. Directly behind the Johanneskirche begins the secured trail, which climbs approximately two kilometers and over 250 meters in elevation through a ruggedly fissured gorge up to Hoch-Imst.

Geological Treasures and the Blaue Grotte

Along the rushing Schinderbach, steep rock walls of Imster Hauptdolomit bear witness to millions of years of mountain formation. At the upper end of the gorge, hikers are welcomed by the Blaue Grotte, a historic mining gallery excavated more than 2,000 years ago in search of galena and silver.
